name: Ananya Reddy
title: Looks exactly like real gold
review: I was nervous ordering imitation jewellery online, but this necklace looks exactly like the pictures — and like real gold. Wore it for a family function and kept getting asked which jeweller I went to. The gold polish is rich, the stones sit well, and it stayed comfortable through the whole evening. Packaging was so pretty I almost did not want to open it.

name: Priya Sharma
title: Everyone thought it was real gold
review: Bought the peacock emerald necklace for my sister’s wedding and we both could not believe the finish. It is lightweight, does not pinch, and the colour did not fade even after a long outdoor function. Friends kept asking if it was temple jewellery from a big store. At this price, I have already added earrings to match.

name: Meera Iyer
title: Perfect for my cousin’s wedding
review: Delivery was quick and the design is elegant — wore it for my cousin’s wedding and it photographed beautifully. The antique polish looks premium in person, not cheap or brassy. I have sensitive skin and usually get a rash from costume jewellery; this was completely fine. Will order a bridal haaram next.

name: Radhika Malhotra
title: Finish still looks new after many wears
review: Great quality and a long-lasting finish. I have worn these bangles for three functions already and they still look premium — no blackening, no dull patches. The stones catch light without looking gaudy. Packaging was gift-ready, so I sent a second set to my friend and she loved it too.

name: Sneha Patel
title: Shipped overseas, arrived beautifully packed
review: I was nervous ordering from abroad but everything arrived on time and packed so carefully. The necklace looks even better in person than on Instagram. I wore it for Diwali with family here and got so many compliments. Kruthika has become my go-to for festive jewellery when I cannot shop in India.

name: Kavya Nair
title: Gifted a set — she loved it
review: The packaging was so beautiful I gifted a necklace and earring set to my friend. She thought I had spent much more. The gold-tone polish looks rich and the pieces feel well made, not hollow or flimsy.

name: Anika Sharma
title: Lightweight all evening
review: Wore the chandelier earrings from morning puja to the reception. No ear pain, no tarnish, and they photographed like real diamonds.

name: Divya Menon
title: Temple look without the weight
review: The Lakshmi motifs look authentic but the piece is so much lighter than real temple jewellery. Only wish I had ordered the matching jada billa in the same order.

name: Tanvi Joshi
title: Skin-friendly, no rash
review: I usually cannot wear imitation jewellery for more than an hour. This was hypoallergenic as promised — no itching, no green marks.

name: Ishita Roy
title: Looks just like the photos
review: Colour, stones, and size all matched the listing. Packed like a gift. Already browsing the bridal collection.

name: Aarohi Jain
title: Compliments all night
review: Wore the AD necklace to a sangeet and people kept asking for the jeweller’s name.

name: Kritika Bose
title: Anti-tarnish really works
review: Stored it properly and it still shines like the day it arrived.

name: Nidhi Gupta
title: Wedding guest ready
review: One necklace and I was fully dressed. Looks expensive, feels light.

name: Simran Batra
title: Second order already
review: Came back for bangles after the necklace. Finish is consistently good.

name: Kavya Reddy
title: Premium imitation done right
review: Gold-like polish, neat stones, and it arrived on time.
